enchantments.tooltip: Shield of Lesser Sunburst: This item blazes with the eternal fury at the heart of a sun. Occasionally, this power comes to the surface, unleashing a nova of light which will blind the struck enemy, dealing severe light damage to it and any other nearby foes.
+5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to Armor Class, attack and damage rolls.
Solar Guard IV: When Hit in Melee: Deals 4 to 16 Light damage to your attacker.

Deathblock IV: Passive: 12% Enhancement Bonus to Negative Energy Absorption. In addition, you are immune to magical effects that can cause instant death.
